title: The query log keeps operational rows in a gated ops sidecar
goal: ql_capture.record writes ops rows with a closed event set and closed keys per event; distill writes them to kb/_querylog/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<run-id>.jsonl, a sidecar like usage/ and work/; querylog.py check refuses an unknown event or key, a free-text value and a leak-scan hit; apply --push copies the directory; the kbgit.py gate and the publish projection treat it as part of kb/_querylog/.

gates.question: This adds a mechanism before a failure it answers has happened (backlog.md, Changing this process). Add it anyway?

The query log would also record operational rows: step and event names, exit codes, millisecond durations, item ids, short shas, test file names and closed reason classes, with no free text, no test node ids and no paths beyond test files. Approve this change to what the query log records?
options: approve: names, exits, milliseconds, item ids, short shas, test file names and closed reason classes only
no: the query log keeps its current rows
gates.recommendation: approve: names, exits, milliseconds, item ids, short shas, test file names and closed reason classes only
gates.answer: approve: names, exits, milliseconds, item ids, short shas, test file names and closed reason classes only

gates.question: Which events and keys does the ops sidecar's closed set start with? The sibling stories write land.step, land.end, sync.gate, done.refused, sprint.close, ci.pipeline, intake.detect, test.run and agent.run rows, and only ST-lopowpsz touches ql_capture.py, so a sibling cannot add an event or key itself. ST-kmsi4dyv's goal also says test.run keeps failed test ids, which the approved scope (no test node ids) does not allow.
options: all nine events, with the keys their goals name, and failed_files (test file names) in place of failed test ids
only the mechanism and the events of this story's tests; each sibling adds its event to ql_capture.OPS_EVENTS
gates.recommendation: all nine events, with the keys their goals name, and failed_files (test file names) in place of failed test ids
gates.answer: all nine events, with the keys their goals name, and failed_files (test file names) in place of failed test ids

notes: The store is a sidecar of kb/_querylog/, so it inherits the query log redaction class, its gates, its GitLab-only delivery and its exclusion from the public projection. A second pusher is not added: kbgit.py sync gives up after two rejected pushes.
